faq: Can you promise a higher App Store ranking?
No. Rankings depend on many things, including downloads, ratings and competition. We make the page clear, accurate and complete, and follow Apple's rules, but we cannot promise a position.
Do you use real screenshots from my app?
Yes. We use real screens from your app, with captions and simple device frames, never fake features. You send a build or screens, and we prepare the sizes Apple requires.
How do you speed up launch time?

We measure with Xcode Instruments, then look at what runs before the first screen appears, such as heavy setup, large assets or network calls. We fix the biggest delays within the limit of your package.
Do I need to be live on the store already?
No. Many owners order before launch. If the app is not live yet, we prepare everything so you can paste it into App Store Connect, or add us to your team and we enter it for you.
